prompts.birthday: Asset: production desktop pet action atlas. Create one SQUARE 4 columns x 4 rows EXACT regular atlas, 16 equal tiles. Actual TRANSPARENT ALPHA background with alpha zero everywhere outside subject. No grids, text, shadows, surface, or environment. Each tile has one SAME photorealistic real golden British shorthair kitten, natural green eyes, cream chest/paws, pink nose, plush fur, full entire body and tail visible, camera eye-level, consistent soft light, NOT cartoon, NOT 3D toy, NO illustration. Keep every silhouette and costume within central 76% of its own tile (12% EMPTY TRANSPARENT margin on every side); no cross-tile overlap. Image 1 is cat identity and exact pose reference; Image 2 is costume identity reference. The kitten wears the specified complete outfit in ALL SIXTEEN poses: fitted to body and head in 3D perspective, bib bends with chest, bonnet wraps head, correctly occluded by fur and paws; NEVER just float clothing above head. Hat cone may naturally tilt when sleeping. NO naked cat frames. All frames consistent fur, head scale, costume identity, studio photographic realism. Reading-order poses: row1: 1 sitting front eyes open; 2 same sitting blink eyes closed; 3 sitting front proud half-closed eyes; 4 sitting head tilt looking up. Row2: 1 side walking RIGHT left forepaw forward; 2 RIGHT walking opposite step; 3 RIGHT walking raised forepaw; 4 RIGHT walking opposite step. Clear side profile body and legs and costume side perspective. Row3: 1 tightly curled asleep side view head on paws eyes closed; 2 same curled sleep subtle head shift; 3 deep forward stretch forelegs extended rump high; 4 sitting licking raised forepaw. Row4: 1 suspended being gently lifted body long relaxed dangling paws NO HANDS; 2 front sitting enjoying petting head raised eyes closed; 3 low crouch ready to pounce side/front three-quarter; 4 eating leaning into small cream bowl. Pose correctness and genuinely transparent background are essential. Outfit: pastel yellow cone birthday hat with pale blue pompom and cream ruffles, pastel pink/yellow scalloped crochet bib. Match the corresponding outfit in Image 2.
